author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수백 마리 · 한 해 내내 머무는 개체도 드물게 기록
summary: 전국의 해안, 호수, 강 하구, 소택지처럼 넓은 물을 낀 곳에서 보이는 겨울철새다. 대개 홀로 지내지만 때로 3~4마리나 큰 무리를 이루기도 한다. 작은 포유류, 새, 물고기 등을 먹으며 연어와 송어를 즐겨 먹는 것으로 알려져 있다. 둥지는 숲속 큰 나무의 가지 위에 나뭇가지를 쌓거나 해안 절벽 등에 지으며, 국외에서는 일본, 중국, 러시아에 분포한다.

points.en: tawny head, paler than the body
brown body with black flight feathers

young: 어린새는 부리와 다리가 흑갈색이다. 머리가 가장 어두운 암갈색이고 몸은 전체적으로 적갈색을 띠며, 꼬리깃에 흰색과 검은색이 섞여 있다.

art.subject: White-tailed Eagle (Haliaeetus albicilla), adult, as seen on Korean estuaries, lakes and coasts from November to March: body and wing coverts brown with paler fringes; head and neck noticeably paler, buff-brown to creamy; flight feathers blackish; tail short, wedge-shaped and pure white; thighs feathered brown. Bill very large, deep and hooked, bright yellow, with a yellow cere; iris pale yellow; bare lower legs and feet bright yellow with black talons.
art.pose: perched on a bare branch near the water's edge
art.scene: Korean winter estuary: wide open water and marsh beside a river mouth; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched: pale buff-brown head, massive yellow bill, brown body, blackish flight feathers, short white wedge-shaped tail, yellow bare legs
adult, flight from below: long broad rectangular wings with blackish flight feathers and fingered tips, head projecting forward, short white wedge-shaped tail
juvenile, side view perched: very dark brown head, dark brown body mottled paler buff, dark grey-brown bill, yellow legs, tail feathers whitish in the centre with dark edges and tips
art.build: Huge eagle, about 84–94cm, far larger than a Black Kite, with a heavy body, large head, thick neck and a massive deep bill. Legs feathered only on the upper part; the lower tarsus bare and yellow. At rest the long broad wings reach about the tail tip, the short tail barely showing beyond them. In flight the wings are very long and broad with parallel edges, like a plank, with deeply fingered tips; the head projects well forward and the short white tail is wedge-shaped.
avoid: Do not paint white shoulders, white thighs or a huge orange bill; that is Steller's Sea Eagle.
Do not give the adult a dark tail or a long square tail like Golden Eagle; the tail is short, wedge-shaped and white.
Do not feather the legs down to the toes; the lower legs are bare and yellow.
Do not paint a pure white head as in Bald Eagle; the adult head is only paler buff-brown.
